title: Heisenberg's uranium program as decoy for a secret electromagnetic isotope separation program
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Heisenberg's uranium program as decoy for a secret electromagnetic isotope separation program, about 1940s at Nazi Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And basically the the picture that emerges is this that the pro the uranium enrichment program that um Heisenberg was running was a red herring

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who writes about secret Nazi programmes, says that in 1940s Germany the uranium project run by the physicist Werner Heisenberg was a red herring, a decoy. Drawing on writers named Hydrick and Farrell and a book called Critical Mass, he says the real work was a hidden programme that used magnets to separate the forms of uranium needed for a bomb. If true, it would mean Nazi Germany's atomic efforts went much further than history records.
